verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party feature for creating general automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled agent runs or rule-based workflows. AgentOS skills run inside the user's agent client (Claude Code, Cursor) as one-off sessions, and the CLI and webhooks are building blocks for scripting the user's own automated systems. Recurring invoices and multi-frequency subscriptions are billing schedules, an adjacent feature rather than user-configurable automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
